title: bundled cedar dispatcher reads the principal from the top-level agent of a wire-shaped snapshot
manifest_yaml:
agent_control_specification_version: 0.4.0-alpha.1
policies:
  p:
    type: cedar
    policy_set: |
      @id("agent_blocked")
      forbid(principal == Agent::"agent-1", action, resource);
      permit(principal, action, resource);
intervention_points:
  pre_tool_call:
    tool_name_from: $snap.tool_call.name
    policy:
      id: p
    policy_target: $snap.tool_call.args
tools:
  pay:
    type: Tool
